title: Preventing Network Attacks
purpose: Preserve original Code First and its answer, original exam questions and answers, previous-learning prompt, old visuals and challenge; bank replacements are teacher-preview only inside You Do. Other phases and ordinary student URLs are untouched.

code_first.code:
authenticated = true
secondFactor = false
if authenticated AND secondFactor then
    print("Allow")
else
    print("Deny")
endif
p: Explain the first assignment or condition that determines the output.
Explain why both checks are combined by AND.
code_first.a: Deny; Allow; both conditions must be true.

original_exam_questions: Explain why encryption protects intercepted information. [3 marks]
The interceptor sees ciphertext; without the relevant key it is not readily readable.
State one role of a firewall. [2 marks]
Allow or block traffic according to filtering rules.
Explain why software updates can improve security. [2 marks]
Fix known vulnerabilities that might otherwise be exploited.

optional_original_challenge.coreHint: Access is granted only if both factors are true.

stretch.task: Add a message to distinguish a missing password check from a missing second factor.
stretch.hint: Test the first condition before the second.
stretch.answer: If password is false -> password check failed; if password true but MFA false -> second factor needed.

mastery.task: Write tests for all four combinations of passwordValid and secondFactorValid, then explain why MFA cannot stop all forms of phishing.
mastery.answer: False/False Deny, False/True Deny, True/False Deny, True/True Allow. MFA limits use of a stolen password but doesn't eliminate account attacks.
